evidence_allocation_policy: Each dimension receives at most one grade. Allocate a shared passage to its best-fitting primary dimension; leave overlapping slots null unless there is a genuinely distinct clause or evidence. Multiple item links and subcontents within a dimension do not create extra grades. Contradictory subcontents within the same dimension require justified mixed/qualified grading, not duplicated opposite scores. Assess all dimensions with distinct evidence, not only the question’s assigned primary.
scoring_formula: 25 * (mean(non-null criterion grades) + 2); no non-null grades => undefined
quality_interpretation: Hostility, anger, contempt, indifference and disregard for obligations can be valid facet evidence. quality.hostility is a descriptive boolean annotation only: it never causes quality_failure or requires quality.evidence. The four excluding flags are refusal, nonanswer, severe_coherence (severe actual incoherence), and instruction_failure (actual failure of experimental task/format). Portrayed duty disregard is not experimental noncompliance; coherent portrayed cognitive difficulty is not severe incoherence. Each true excluding flag needs literal quality evidence. Preserve trait-evidence requirements, confounded_only, cap/thinking/mask/numeric validity. Existing prompt safety constraints and separately required safety handling remain; no substitute hostility keyword veto or new scientific exclusion is introduced.
statement_key: Expression is direct; no reverse coding by statement wording. A category alone is not enough.
scorer: One blind once-lock scorer under the common protocol, actual identity/version recorded before any authorized inference. No additional execution rater, adjudication or author scoring of model answers.

approved_eligibility_amendment.change: Hostility removed from automatic eligibility exclusion

criteria.label: Order and regularity preference
criteria.definition: Liking order/regularity and being bothered by disorder versus comfort with it.
criteria.high_evidence: Enjoys orderly systematic arrangements and regularity; disorder itself can bother them.
criteria.low_evidence: Is comfortable with disorder and has little need for systematic arrangement or regularity.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Utility, hygiene and safety alone are ambiguous; an untidy room may coexist with a strong preference for order.

criteria.label: Tidying and returning belongings
criteria.definition: Liking to tidy and returning objects versus forgetting, leaving belongings around and room mess.
criteria.high_evidence: Likes tidying and commonly returns belongings to places or restores own space.
criteria.low_evidence: Leaves belongings scattered, forgets to return them, or leaves own room messy.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. The four item links are one behavior family, not four grades. Lack of storage or physical access alone is ambiguous; a stated habit still counts.

criteria.label: Wanting things just right
criteria.definition: Exactness or dissatisfaction with imperfect details, retained without requiring practical benefit.
criteria.high_evidence: Wants details to be just right and is bothered by small imperfections.
criteria.low_evidence: Is content with an imperfect result and does not need every detail precisely right.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Not a diagnosis or a universal quality/achievement standard. C4 standards overlap remains; prompt wording targets ordinary low-stakes details.

criteria.label: Doing things according to a plan
criteria.definition: Using a plan that guides actions versus proceeding without a planned order.
criteria.high_evidence: Ordinarily does activities according to an organized plan or sequence.
criteria.low_evidence: Ordinarily proceeds as things occur without an advance plan guiding action.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Planning content is retained despite C6/O4 overlap. Completing a task, cautious deliberation, or merely owning a calendar is not enough.

criteria.label: Being bothered by messy people
criteria.definition: Reaction to messy people’s ordinary untidiness, distinct from one’s own room or tidying.
criteria.high_evidence: Is bothered by other people’s messy habits even without practical harm.
criteria.low_evidence: Is unbothered by messy people and comfortable around their untidiness.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Tolerance of another person’s mess can coexist with own neatness. A4 conflict, A3 kindness and hygiene judgments do not substitute for mess-specific reaction.

boundary_controls.definition: Actual task/format compliance is distinct from coherent portrayal of distress, ability difficulty, distrust, harsh cynicism or disorder.
An external constraint or justified one-off response alone is ambiguous; explicit habitual target evidence may coexist with it.
Preference and behavior can disagree; others’ mess, just-right exactness and doing things by plan remain distinct content despite neighbor overlap.
Do not grade moral worth, politeness, verbosity, safety boilerplate or how helpful the response sounds instead of the item-grounded target.
